name: Locate Plus
description: Find any block, entity or item, not just structures. Adds /locate block, /locate entity and /locate item, which tracks an item down in chests, on the ground, on mobs and in player inventories. Surveys whole areas with /lp analyze, reads everything about a position with /lp inspect, marks what it finds with an outline you can see through terrain, and teleports without dropping you inside a wall. Exports to a text file and is configurable. Server-side only, no client install needed. Type /lp for the command list.
